note: Four-VM owner estate after migration: Netcup Dial Control plus exactly three retained Oracle VMs (van-trading-core, vekl-worker, oracle-admin), all peers of the Netcup WireGuard hub. During migration a fifth, transient Oracle A1 exists: dial-hermes-control, the old Oracle DIAL/Hermes control source. Hermes and its files are cloned from it to Netcup, its control units are retired, and the owner then terminates the instance. It is a separate physical VM, never the same VM as van-trading-core (owner topology decision 2026-09-23). DIAL resource-fabric hosts.json governs the DIAL infrastructure nodes; VAN/VATI authority for van-trading-core remains governed by the VAN repository.

retired_after_cutover.physical_instance: separate Oracle A1 VM named dial-hermes-control; never van-trading-core
retired_after_cutover.condition: Only after the final Hermes/control delta is cloned to Netcup, Netcup CORE_DEVELOPMENT verification is green, the private overlay is verified, identities are rotated, and Dial Control is active.
retired_after_cutover.certification_requires: OCI lifecycle-state TERMINATED or TERMINATING for DIAL_HERMES_CONTROL_SOURCE_OCID

private_overlay.rule: Each Oracle VM is an independent outbound peer to Netcup; oracle-admin is not a transit dependency.

lifecycle_rules.oracle_a1_transition: old-dial-hermes-control is the separate dial-hermes-control A1 (migration source), enrolled as a transient overlay peer at 10.77.0.5 only until retired; it is never the van-trading-core VM and is terminated by the owner after cloning.
lifecycle_rules.source_retirement: Final zero-touch certification is forbidden until van-trading-core (10.77.0.4) answers as itself, the migration source is no longer an overlay peer, and OCI reports DIAL_HERMES_CONTROL_SOURCE_OCID as TERMINATED or TERMINATING.

sequence: 2 clone Hermes installation and files from dial-hermes-control to Netcup and verify
3 rebuild oracle-admin and vekl-worker (terminate preserving boot volume, relaunch same shape, subnet and private IP; cloud-init grants ocarun sudo; Run Command and Bastion plugins enabled)
4 after step 2 is verified, reinstall dial-hermes-control and bootstrap it as van-trading-core
5 terminate the previous van-trading-core instance (VATI never ran on it)
